mechanism: 只用一条连续可追踪的悬浮织物作为字幕载体，让移动光球、阴影、条纹切片与柔性褶皱依次改变文字的显隐和尺度；每条职员表都绑定一次可见材质变形，最后织物退出黑场而不混入无关画面。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One continuous flexible carrier remains identifiable from opening through the final title.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One continuous flexible carrier remains identifiable from opening through the final title."

invariants.rule: Every credit appears only after one visible light, pressure, fold or occlusion event acts on that carrier.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "Every credit appears only after one visible light, pressure, fold or occlusion event acts on that carrier."

invariants.rule: Deformation may distort text transiently but each exact credit must recover to a readable state.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Deformation may distort text transiently but each exact credit must recover to a readable state."

invariants.rule: Color and graphic overlays never replace the underlying cloth or introduce a second unrelated scene.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "Color and graphic overlays never replace the underlying cloth or introduce a second unrelated scene."

invariants.rule: The terminal title is held on the released carrier before the same material exits into black.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The terminal title is held on the released carrier before the same material exits into black."

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: all source faces, bodies, wardrobe, identities and creator-specific character designs
the source location, set dressing, props, products and exact environmental geometry
all source words, logos, watermarks, typefaces and brand identifiers
the source choreography, exact camera path, shot durations and transition timing
the source palette, signature effects, prompt wording, creator handle and narrative particulars
